title: Warranty, Useful Lifetime and Repair Values — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Warranty, Useful Lifetime and Repair Values — PAP Therapy Equipment

These values govern a PAP Therapy Equipment device after delivery, by device class: the manufacturer warranty on the base device and its reasonable useful lifetime, both counted in calendar months from the setup date; the labor rate per 15-minute unit on a repair of a patient-owned device (billed as K0739); the repair cost, as a percentage of the class's fee-schedule purchase amount, above which the device is replaced instead of repaired; whether a replacement ordered after the useful lifetime needs a new in-person practitioner visit; and whether a replacement for loss or theft before the end of the useful lifetime needs a police, fire or insurance report.

| Device class | Manufacturer warranty (months) | Useful lifetime (months) | Labor rate per unit (USD) | Replace when repair exceeds (percent of purchase amount) | New practitioner visit for an age-based replacement | Police, fire or insurance report for loss or theft |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Travel CPAP System (E0601) | 24 | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | no | no |
| CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601) | 24 | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | yes | yes |
| Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) | 24 | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | yes | yes |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) | 24 | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | yes | yes |
| Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471) | 24 | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | yes | yes |
| Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471) | 24 | 60 | 23.86 | 100 | yes | yes |

## Worked figures (hypothetical repair jobs)

- Labor of 6 units on any class is 6 multiplied by 23.86, or 143.16.
- At 100 percent, the replace-instead line of a CPAP class is its full fee-schedule purchase amount of 862.40: a repair whose labor and parts total 862.40 is at the line and not above it, while a total of 862.41 is above it.
- A device set up on 15 March is 24 months past its setup date on 15 March two years later.
